_about: Render commands per template for run_daily.ps1. Each step is null (TODO: not wired; the story is skipped and the log says so), [] (nothing to run: another step does it) or an argument array run from 'cwd' with placeholders {python} {node} {tools} {data} {out} {story_id} {date} {slot}. {data} = the story's data.json (schema rtv-daily-story/1, written by daily.py stories), {out} = the story's work directory. Steps run in order data -> render -> qa -> package; every configured step must exit 0. After them {out} must hold post-package.json and either the three MP4s or PNG / JPEG images.
